item.title: Slow second half haunts Panthers in loss to UT Martin
item.description: Eastern’s late run in the final minutes was not enough to overcome early second half struggles in a 76-68 loss to UT Martin Thursday evening at Groniger Arena. The Panthers (9-13, 5-6) went into the locker room at halftime tied with the Skyhawks 37-37. item.title: EIU executive director of university housing and dining services, dean of students to retire
item.description: Two administrators at Eastern Illinois University are retiring on Jan. 31: Executive Director of University Housing and Dining Services Mark Hudson and Dean of Students Jody Stone. item.title: EIU changes 4 parking lots to be accessible for students
item.description: The Eastern Illinois University Parking Advisory Committee has reclassified four parking lots across campus so that they may be used for both staff and student parking.
